HARD_GATE.description: 违反即阻断当前动作或阶段推进。

REQUIRED.description: 执行当前动作前必须满足；缺失时不得静默降级。

RECOMMENDED.description: 建议满足；缺失时必须显式记录取舍和风险。

EXAMPLE.description: 示例或参考，不构成事实、权限或完成门禁。

governancePolicy.resourcePrioritySeparation: hardConstraintLevels govern rule severity; resourceCatalog.priorityClass governs context reading priority and must not be used as a substitute.
